generate_vasp_inputs_for_top_k_configs: run write_top_k_vasp.py with --cache and --k to generate VASP input files for the best k configurations per system
write_single_point_vasp_inputs: run write_top_k_vasp.py with --sp flag to write VASP input files for single point calculations instead of relaxations
load_sorted_cache_and_extract_top_k: run write_top_k_vasp.py with --cache to load a sorted-by-energy pickle cache and extract top k configurations
write_paths_list_for_batch_jobs: run write_top_k_vasp.py with --outdir to generate a paths_list.txt file listing all VASP input directories for batch submission
save_top_k_cache_pickle: run write_top_k_vasp.py with --k to save a filtered top k cache as a new pickle file alongside the original cache
